inputs.blast_radius: Audience reached: open_large (Open to anyone, thousands or more, or growing without a ceiling). Tenancy: multi_tenant_shared_store (Many customers' rows in the same tables, separated by application or policy logic). Privileged operations available: external_side_effects (Sends email or messages, calls paid third-party APIs, or acts in external systems). inputs.plausibility_rationale: Exposure starts at 'expected' for environment 'public_release': where the application runs decides who can reach a weakness at all. Publicly discoverable deployments are enumerated by untargeted automation as a matter of routine. An attacker can always obtain a legitimate authenticated position by signing up. Exposure may only be reduced by hard network facts, and by at most one evidenced compensating control on top. Raising is capped at one step because the environment base already carries the dominant signal.
